events.title: Día de los Muertos at NYBG
events.what: Marigolds, a community ofrenda and flower-covered figures celebrate remembrance. Make papel picado or silk flowers during the scheduled workshops. The special November 2 program runs on a Monday; the display closes at 5 p.m. on Nov 1 and 2.
events.where: New York Botanical Garden, the Bronx
events.when: Through Nov 2 · Oct 31 & Nov 2 crafts 1–5 p.m.; Nov 1 parade 2 p.m.
events.cost: Included with All-Garden Pass: adults $35 weekdays / $39 weekends. Do not assume a grounds-only ticket covers the exhibition.
events.imageAlt: NYBG seasonal ofrenda display

events.title: Oktoberfest at Watermark
events.what: Waterfront Oktoberfest with German beer, food, and seasonal decorations. Reservations and paid packages are available.
events.when: Sep 10–Oct 31 · check the organizer for daily hours
events.cost: General admission is free; food, drinks, and packages cost extra.
events.imageAlt: Watermark Oktoberfest in a previous season

events.title: Roy Lichtenstein: Like New
events.what: The Lichtenstein retrospective brings together familiar Pop images and less-seen works, including recreations of four murals. An indoor art option that can pair with a walk through the Meatpacking District.
events.when: Oct 11, 2026–May 10, 2027 · closed Tuesdays; Fridays open until 10 p.m.
events.cost: Standard adult admission $30; ages 25 and under free. Check free-admission dates and reserve.
events.imageAlt: Roy Lichtenstein, Girl in Window, 1963; © Estate of Roy Lichtenstein, courtesy Whitney Museum

events.title: The Surrealist Book: Tomorrow Lives in Mirrors
events.what: Newly opened: unusual artists’ books, collage-filled sketchbooks and sculptural bindings by Surrealists including Dalí, Cahun and Unica Zürn. Explore how a book can become an artwork.
events.when: Oct 4, 2026–Jan 23, 2027 · 10:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; Fridays until 8:30 p.m.
events.cost: Adult admission $30; special exhibitions included. NY State residents can reserve free Friday evening tickets.
events.imageAlt: Unica Zürn, Oracle and Spectacle, Book IV, 1960. MoMA; gift of Helen and Sam Zell. Photo: Ben Blackwell. © Verlag Brinkmann & Bose, Berlin.

events.title: A guided look at autumn flowers
events.what: Garden Guides lead an hour-long walk through autumn foliage, fruits and flowers. Meet on Magnolia Plaza by the building steps; no separate tour registration is required. Weather can cancel the walk.
events.cost: Tour included with admission: adult $22 at the box office / $23.67 online
events.imageAlt: Hardy begonias in the garden, photograph by Michael Stewart

events.title: Queens Night Market’s final Saturday
events.where: Behind New York Hall of Science · 47-01 111th Street
events.cost: Free admission; food is priced by each vendor.
events.what: The outdoor market wraps up its 2026 season with one last Saturday of international food stalls. Browse first, choose a few dishes to share and dress for an evening outside.
events.imageAlt: Queens Night Market organizer photograph

events.title: Pick a pumpkin at Queens Farm
events.where: Queens County Farm Museum · 73-50 Little Neck Parkway
events.when: Through Oct 31 · weekdays 1–5 p.m.; weekends 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
events.cost: Free patch admission except Oct 31, when a Halloween on the Farm ticket is required. Pumpkins cost extra.
events.what: A pumpkin-picking option within the city. Combine the patch with a walk around the historic farm; allow extra travel time to eastern Queens.
events.imageAlt: Pumpkins at Queens County Farm Museum

events.title: Locating Girlhood opens at AFAM
events.where: American Folk Art Museum · 2 Lincoln Square
events.when: Oct 9–Feb 28 · Wed–Sun 11:30 a.m.–6 p.m.; closed Mon–Tue
events.cost: Free admission.
events.what: A new exhibition of roughly 100 works made by early American girls, including elaborate needlework, maps and painted objects. A compact, free art stop when you want something beyond shopping.
events.imageAlt: Needlework picture attributed to Faith Trumbull; Connecticut Museum / AFAM exhibition image

events.title: Outdoor skating at Rockefeller Center
events.when: Season open through March 27, 2027 · daily sessions; check the booking calendar
events.cost: Skating from $22; skate rental $12 extra. Prices vary by session.
events.what: The outdoor rink is open for the season. Reserve a 60-minute session and check the arrival instructions on your ticket; session prices and availability vary.
events.imageAlt: The Rink at Rockefeller Center at night, organizer promotional photograph

events.title: Boo at the Zoo
events.cost: Dated zoo admission; price varies
events.what: Halloween programming alongside an autumn zoo visit, on weekends and the Oct 12 holiday. This is a family-oriented festival; choose it for animals, pumpkins and daytime fall atmosphere.
events.imageAlt: Bronx Zoo — image supplied on the organizer website

events.title: Halloween movie nights at Sadie’s
events.cost: Free screening; food and drinks optional and extra
events.what: The remaining outdoor screening is Hocus Pocus on Oct 28. Bring an extra layer for the Garden Bar lawn; food and drinks are optional purchases.
events.imageAlt: Sadie’s official venue photograph

events.title: Halloween Harvest at Luna Park
events.what: Coney Island’s autumn season combines rides with pumpkin decorating and harvest activities. Choose an operating date and a wristband that includes the activities you want; the park is not open every day.
events.when: Through Nov 1 · operating dates and hours vary; check the park calendar.
events.cost: Paid wristband; live price depends on visit date and height. Confirm before booking.
events.imageAlt: Luna Park’s official photograph of a previous Halloween Harvest

events.title: Village Halloween Parade
events.what: Costumes, puppets and music fill Sixth Avenue. This year’s Body & Soul theme includes new Firehorse puppets. Public viewing is open to everyone; costume required to join the march.
events.where: Sixth Avenue · Canal Street to 16th Street
events.when: Oct 31 · parade starts 7 p.m. · rain or shine
events.cost: Free public viewing and costumed participation; special-access tickets extra.
events.imageAlt: Costumed participant in an official Village Halloween Parade photograph

events.title: Halloween Harvest + dog costume contest
events.what: Spend Halloween on the Astoria waterfront with art workshops from noon to 3 p.m., followed by the park’s dog costume contest. Free RSVP; food purchases are optional.
events.when: Oct 31 · noon–5 p.m.; dog costume contest 3–5 p.m.
events.cost: Free with RSVP; food purchases extra.
events.imageAlt: Socrates Sculpture Park’s official Halloween Harvest photograph

events.title: Halloween at Queens Botanical Garden
events.what: Fall foliage, a vendor fair and a harvest beer-and-cider bar, alongside family crafts and performances. A garden outing with Halloween festivities rather than a late-night party.
events.cost: $10 nonmember adult; $8 child; members free. Food and drinks extra.
events.imageAlt: Halloween at the Garden in 2024; photo by Eryn Hatzithomas

events.title: Wave Hill-O-Ween
events.what: An outdoor Halloween afternoon with a garden scavenger hunt, music on the lawn, autumn views and a drop-in art activity. This is a family-oriented event; register through the garden.
events.cost: Free event and grounds admission that Thursday.
events.imageAlt: Wave Hill Halloween photograph by Dave Sanders

events.title: Black Lagoon Halloween cocktail pop-up
events.what: Someday Bar hosts the spooky cocktail takeover with eerie decor and seasonal drinks. The organizer lists the Brooklyn run through Nov 1; the venue manages its own hours and reservations.
events.cost: Drinks and food charged individually; current pop-up menu prices not confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Official Black Lagoon photograph from its 2023 Los Angeles installation; Brooklyn decor may differ

events.title: Catbaret: Meowloween!
events.what: A cat-themed Halloween variety show with comedy, music and performers including Vickie Wang and Gemma Smith. Choose an in-person ticket; the cheaper livestream is a separate option.
events.cost: $30.08 standard online admission including fees; $35 at the door. No drink minimum; 21+.
events.imageAlt: Caveat’s performance space in its official venue photograph.

events.title: GoCafe experience at Grand Central
events.what: Try the brand’s portable coffee gear and see live demonstrations in Graybar Passage. Browse new colors; some gifts require a purchase or a social post, so check the on-site conditions.
events.cost: Product purchases extra; admission fee not listed.
events.imageAlt: Zojirushi’s official GoCafe mug photograph; not an image of the Grand Central installation.

events.title: Spooky City at the Museum
events.what: A family-oriented museum Halloween day with scavenger hunts, storytelling, African dance and drumming, costumes and a DJ. Registration is available through the museum.
events.where: Museum of the City of New York · 1220 Fifth Avenue
events.cost: Included with museum admission; check the applicable ticket rate.
events.source: Museum of the City of New York
events.imageAlt: Children in Halloween costumes, 1940; Alexander Alland, MCNY collection 94.104.3

events.title: Blood Manor: a haunted-house night
events.when: Selected nights through Nov 7; Oct 21 6–10 p.m., Oct 22 7–11 p.m., Oct 23–24 7 p.m.–midnight
events.what: An actor-led haunted attraction for a scarier Halloween outing. Book a timed ticket and check the specific night: hours change, and the November finale uses a lights-out format.
events.cost: Paid timed tickets; current checkout price not independently confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Blood Manor performer; official attraction photograph.

events.title: Halloween beneath the blue whale
events.what: A family-oriented museum celebration with dancing, crafts and marine-biology activities beneath the blue whale. Costumes are welcome; masks are not. Event tickets require separate museum admission.
events.where: American Museum of Natural History · 200 Central Park West
events.cost: Event from $25 plus required museum admission; member event tickets from $15.
events.imageAlt: Halloween celebration photograph by Alvaro Keding, courtesy of AMNH.

events.title: Downtown Halloween Bar Fest
events.when: Oct 31 · noon–8 p.m.; check-in noon–4 p.m.
events.what: Start at Hotel Chantelle for a Halloween bar crawl across participating downtown venues. Check in during the stated window; drinks and any individual venue rules are separate from the crawl ticket.
events.cost: Tickets advertised from $18; drinks extra. 21+ with ID.
events.imageAlt: Hotel Chantelle rooftop; official venue photograph.

events.title: Candlelight Halloween at Vessel
events.when: Oct 31 · 9 p.m.; doors 45 minutes before; 60-minute concert
events.what: The Highline String Quartet plays Halloween music inside Vessel. This is a standing-only concert with no late entry; the organizer states the concert is not ADA-accessible.
events.cost: $70 ticket plus $5.60 fee shown at check; availability may change.
events.imageAlt: Violin and Halloween decorations in Fever’s official concert promotional photograph.

events.title: Spooktober at Prospect Park Zoo
events.when: October weekends; remaining dates Oct 24, 25 and 31 · 10 a.m.–5:30 p.m.
events.what: A small-zoo visit with seasonal activities included in admission. A lighter, family-friendly Halloween option; last admission is 4:30 p.m. Check the day’s activity schedule when booking.
events.cost: Adult admission $10.95; Spooktober activities included.
events.imageAlt: North American river otters at Prospect Park Zoo; official WCS venue photograph.

events.title: The Haunted Festival at HK Hall
events.what: A late-night Halloween dance party across four themed floors, with DJs and live performers. This is a 21+ nightlife option; bring ID. Bags and heavy coats require coat check.
events.cost: Paid tickets; current ticket tier and coat-check charge not independently confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Performer from the Haunted Festival’s official event page.

events.title: Natalino’s four-day tailoring pop-up
events.when: Oct 29–Nov 1; daily opening hours not posted
events.what: Try on the online-led label’s Italian-inspired tailoring, knitwear and shirting in person. A menswear discovery for browsing fabrics and fit, rather than a claimed favorite brand.
events.cost: Shopping prices vary; organizer does not list an admission charge.
events.imageAlt: Natalino clothing in the organizer’s official pop-up photograph.

events.title: Nuulee’s Mongolian cashmere pop-up
events.what: Browse Mongolian cashmere and winter knitwear at a temporary Nolita shop. A seasonal shopping discovery; this is not a claim that you have purchased from the brand.
events.cost: Items priced individually; admission charge not listed.
events.imageAlt: Nuulee product photograph supplied by its pop-up organizer.

events.title: Halloween mini golf at Swingers NoMad
events.when: Oct 31 · all day; choose a timed golf slot. Costume offer until 7 p.m.
events.what: Three mini-golf courses get Halloween decorations, with entertainers and a DJ. Arriving in costume earns a second golf round free until 7 p.m. Family sessions are separate from regular 21+ play; select the appropriate booking.
events.cost: Paid golf booking; price varies by slot/package. Second round free for costumed guests until 7 p.m.; food and drinks extra.
events.imageAlt: Swingers NoMad’s indoor mini-golf course; official venue photograph.

events.title: The Vampire Ball
events.when: Oct 30 & 31 · Oct 31 session 9 p.m.–5 a.m. Nov 1
events.cost: Paid single-night or two-night passes; live tier prices vary.
events.what: Ten stages, interactive art and a blood-rave theme across the warehouse complex. Ages 21+ with valid ID. Choose a dated ticket; this is an overnight party.
events.imageAlt: The Vampire Ball — organizer or venue image

events.title: Kenny Scharf’s colorful Rockefeller takeover
events.when: Through Nov 1 · public outdoor displays accessible without a ticket
events.cost: Free public art; Top of the Rock admission is separate.
events.what: Look for Scharf’s cartoon-like characters across flags and public spaces in this Art in Focus installation. A short, cheerful art detour; do not buy an observation-deck ticket just to see the outdoor work.
events.imageAlt: Kenny Scharf’s colorful Rockefeller takeover — organizer or venue image

events.title: Ascarium at the New York Aquarium
events.when: Remaining weekends: Oct 24–25 & 31 · activities 11 a.m.–4 p.m.
events.cost: Included with paid aquarium admission; dated ticket prices vary.
events.what: Marine creatures meet Halloween activities and optical illusions. A family-oriented option, with the aquarium’s animal exhibits as the main attraction. Reserve a dated admission ticket.
events.imageAlt: Ascarium at the New York Aquarium — organizer or venue image

events.title: The Great Jack O’Lantern Blaze
events.when: Selected evenings through Nov 8 · timed entry
events.where: Van Cortlandt Manor · 525 S Riverside Avenue
events.cost: $24 Mon–Thu after 8 p.m. through Oct 29; other sessions and transport cost extra.
events.what: Walk among thousands of hand-carved illuminated pumpkins, new storybook displays and a longer trail. This is a ticketed Hudson Valley trip, not a Manhattan walk. Reserve the exact session before traveling.
events.imageAlt: The Great Jack O’Lantern Blaze — organizer or venue image

events.title: Brancusi: The Artist and His Studio
events.cost: Paid museum admission; eligible discounts and special free-entry rules vary.
events.what: A major exhibition connects Brancusi’s sculptures with his studio, photographs and films. Oct 22–24 are member previews; general visitors should plan for Oct 25 onward.
events.imageAlt: Brancusi: The Artist and His Studio — organizer or venue image

events.title: Cheer on the NYC Marathon
events.when: Nov 1 · race morning into afternoon; arrival varies by course mile
events.where: Five-borough course · choose a public sidewalk viewing spot
events.neighborhood: Citywide · First Avenue on the Upper East Side is one option
events.cost: Free public-sidewalk spectating; reserved grandstands are separate.
events.what: Bring a warm layer and cheer for runners on the course. Expect major road closures and difficult cross-street access; choose your side of the course before heading out.
events.imageAlt: Cheer on the NYC Marathon — organizer or venue image

events.title: 50 Years Through the Five Boroughs
events.where: Vanderbilt Hall · Grand Central Terminal, 89 East 42nd St
events.cost: Public terminal installation; no admission charge listed.
events.what: NYRR celebrates the marathon’s five-borough route with interactive displays, DJs, a projected name wall and giveaways. A short indoor stop ahead of race weekend.
events.imageAlt: Vanderbilt Hall at Grand Central Terminal during an earlier event; venue photograph

events.title: Bryant Park Winter Village opens
events.where: Bryant Park · Sixth Avenue at 42nd Street
events.when: Opens Oct 28; rink season through Feb 28, 2027
events.cost: Free entry and skating admission with your own skates. Rentals $18.72–$64.48 before tax; reserve.
events.what: The winter market and rink return. Save this opening if you want a skating outing; the organizer lists a noon opening event, so check your reserved slot rather than assuming regular morning hours apply that day.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: NYBG fall foliage tour
events.where: Reflecting Pool · Leon Levy Visitor Center, New York Botanical Garden
events.when: Oct 24 at 11:30 a.m. & Oct 31 at 1 p.m.
events.cost: Included in an All-Garden Pass; confirm the date-specific ticket price.
events.what: Join a guided look at the garden’s changing autumn colors. The tour has a fixed start, so allow time to reach the visitor center after entering.
events.imageAlt: Autumn forest path at NYBG, organizer photograph

events.title: Merchant’s House candlelight ghost tours
events.where: Merchant’s House Museum · enter through Manuel Plaza, 35 East 4th Street
events.when: Remaining dates Oct 23–24 & 29–30 · departures every half hour, 6:30–9 p.m.
events.cost: $45; museum members $35.
events.what: A candlelit tour of the preserved 19th-century house, with guides recounting its ghost stories and reported paranormal encounters. Book a departure. During restoration, use the Manuel Plaza entrance. Photo shows the historic passageway.
events.imageAlt: Merchant’s House historic passageway; photograph by Max Touhey

events.title: Pumpkins and a corn maze at Lakeside
events.when: Through Nov 1 · Thu–Fri 4–10 p.m., Sat–Sun 11 a.m.–11 p.m.
events.where: LeFrak Center at Lakeside · Prospect Park
events.cost: Entry, pumpkin-patch entry and photo ops free; corn maze $5, pumpkin $10, carnival games $3.
events.what: A lakeside fall festival with pumpkins, seasonal games and a small corn maze. Activities are separately priced; a ticket to the haunted attraction is a separate purchase.
events.imageAlt: Pumpkins and a corn maze at Lakeside — organizer image

events.title: Help the Wetlab fish return to the Hudson
events.cost: Public park program; no admission charge listed.
events.what: The River Project closes the Wetlab season by releasing its fish residents. Meet the researchers, learn about local wildlife and watch or help with the release; family-friendly crafts are also offered.
events.imageAlt: Help the Wetlab fish return to the Hudson — organizer image

events.title: Chamber music and Halloween on Governors Island
events.cost: Free; optional donation and ferry fare extra.
events.what: Glass Clouds Ensemble’s season finale combines chamber music with a Halloween celebration. An afternoon outing in the island’s historic houses; allow time for the ferry.
events.imageAlt: Chamber music and Halloween on Governors Island — organizer image

events.title: Free Halloween DJ night at the Whitney
events.cost: Free Friday Night admission; reserve a ticket. Food and drinks extra.
events.what: TYLERFROMWHERE and Lord Fascinator play throughout the evening, with gallery access and terrace views. This is the public Friday event, not the separate members-only party.
events.imageAlt: Free Halloween DJ night at the Whitney — organizer image

events.title: Ghosts of New York costume party
events.where: Museum of the City of New York · 1220 Fifth Avenue
events.cost: $20 adults and members; $15 seniors and students. Food and drinks extra.
events.what: Dress as the ghost of a famous New Yorker for live tribute and drag performances, DJ Misbehaviour, dancing and costume prizes. New York at Its Core stays open for an after-hours look.
events.source: Museum of the City of New York
events.imageAlt: Ghosts of New York costume party — organizer image

events.title: Halloween by the harbor at Brookfield Place
events.when: Oct 30 noon–store close; Oct 31 10 a.m.–store close. Brewery party Oct 31, 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m.
events.cost: Public complex entry free; drinks and purchases extra.
events.what: The complex has family trick-or-treating, while Sixpoint Brewery adds live music, a costume contest and drink specials on Halloween. Choose the brewery portion for a more grown-up stop; families are still welcome.
events.imageAlt: Halloween by the harbor at Brookfield Place — organizer image

events.title: Día de Muertos in Flatiron
events.when: Community altar Oct 26–Nov 3; celebration Oct 28, 3–7 p.m.
events.where: Flatiron North Plaza · Broadway at 23rd Street
events.cost: Free; optional neighborhood food purchases extra.
events.what: Visit Twenty Petal Flower, a community altar by Mestiz Studio and Powerhouse Arts. The celebration adds folkloric dance, live music, flower-making and printmaking. Photo shows a previous edition of the annual event.
events.imageAlt: Día de Muertos in Flatiron — organizer image

events.title: Carved-pumpkin display in East Midtown
events.where: 919 Third Avenue and surrounding participating businesses
events.cost: Free neighborhood event; optional purchases extra.
events.what: See the Maniac Pumpkin jack-o’-lantern display as the neighborhood’s Halloween trail returns. This is primarily a family trick-or-treat event; the pumpkin artistry is the suggested quick stop.
events.imageAlt: Carved-pumpkin display in East Midtown — organizer image

events.title: An illuminated Forbidden Forest trail
events.when: Upcoming bookable evenings Oct 23–25 & 28–31 · timed entry; later sessions also offered
events.where: Franklin D. Roosevelt State Park · 2957 Crompond Road
events.cost: Tickets currently from $28.72 promotional price; selected nights cost more. Parking $15 online / $20 onsite.
events.what: Walk through an outdoor Harry Potter-themed light trail with interactive scenes and magical creatures. Allow roughly an hour plus travel; this is a Westchester trip, not a city walk. Uneven woodland paths and flashing effects may matter.
events.imageAlt: An illuminated Forbidden Forest trail — organizer image

events.title: Topaz Jones: free hip-hop, funk and soul
events.cost: Free, first come first served. Free Fast Track reservations open Oct 26 at noon.
events.what: The rapper, producer and filmmaker marks ten years of Arcade with a genre-crossing set. A music discovery, not a claim that he is already a favorite artist. Arrive early if entering without Fast Track.
events.imageAlt: Topaz Jones: free hip-hop, funk and soul — organizer image

events.title: Orchestra in Miniature: chamber duets
events.cost: Free, first come first served. Free Fast Track reservations open Oct 26 at noon.
events.what: Festival Orchestra musicians pair up for intimate instrumental duets, including Bach and Glière. A compact classical concert with no ticket charge; entry is subject to capacity.
events.imageAlt: Orchestra in Miniature: chamber duets — organizer image

events.title: Houdini’s life and afterlife in the Village
events.where: Church of the Village · 201 West 13th Street
events.cost: Free; advance registration required.
events.what: A panel explores Houdini’s New York career, stage magic and encounters with spiritualism, marking a century since his death. Hosted with Boroughs of the Dead and the Merchant’s House Museum.
events.imageAlt: Houdini’s life and afterlife in the Village — organizer image

events.title: A colorful OLLY pop-up at Hudson Yards
events.where: Hudson Yards public spaces · see organizer directions
events.cost: Admission charge not listed; check event details before visiting.
events.what: Four immersive spaces introduce OLLY’s Mochi Bites. Treat this as a short design and brand-pop-up discovery, not a health recommendation; sampling is optional and ingredients should be checked.
events.imageAlt: A colorful OLLY pop-up at Hudson Yards — organizer image

events.title: Grieg’s piano concerto in an intimate hall
events.where: Victor Borge Hall · Scandinavia House, 58 Park Avenue
events.cost: Paid concert; confirm the current ticket price at checkout.
events.what: Per Tengstrand and a Princeton string quartet perform his chamber arrangement of Grieg’s concerto, alongside Mendelssohn and Schumann. Played on Victor Borge’s own Steinway.
events.imageAlt: Grieg’s piano concerto in an intimate hall — organizer image

events.title: Kiku: Japanese chrysanthemums at NYBG
events.what: Chrysanthemums trained into arches, cascades and intricate traditional forms fill the Nolen Greenhouses. The Nov 7–8 highlight weekend adds crafts and taiko performances; garden travel is extra.
events.where: New York Botanical Garden · Nolen Greenhouses
events.when: Oct 31–Nov 15 · 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; highlight weekend Nov 7–8, noon–4 p.m.
events.cost: Garden ticket required; current ticket price not confirmed. Check the linked ticket options.
events.imageAlt: Trained pink and yellow chrysanthemums inside an NYBG greenhouse

events.title: Witches Night Out at Sadie’s
events.what: A costume-friendly garden-bar evening with tarot, a DJ and witch-hat decorating. A complimentary cocktail toast starts at 6 p.m. for ages 21+, while supplies last; the first 100 guests can make a candy bag.
events.cost: Admission charge not stated; additional food and drinks cost extra.
events.imageAlt: Guests at Sadie’s in a photograph from the venue’s archive

events.title: Halloween dance party on the Pier 17 rooftop
events.what: Krewella, Nervo, Arty and Dvbbs headline an outdoor Halloween dance event overlooking the East River. The show runs rain or shine, so plan warm layers.
events.where: The Rooftop at Pier 17 · 89 South Street
events.when: Sat Oct 31 · doors and music 3 p.m.; ends by 10 p.m.
events.cost: Paid AXS tickets; live price and age restrictions should be checked before booking.
events.imageAlt: A previous concert on the Rooftop at Pier 17

events.title: Pumpkin carving in a Brooklyn community garden
events.what: Bring your own pumpkin or help carve one for the garden’s Halloween display. The group will compost the pumpkin insides together. A small, hands-on neighborhood outing.
events.cost: No participation price listed; bring your own pumpkin if carving one to take home.
events.imageAlt: People carving pumpkins at a table in The Secret Garden

events.title: Get Out with the New York Philharmonic
events.what: Watch Jordan Peele’s film while the orchestra performs Michael Abels’s score live, conducted by Anthony Parnther with the DC6 Singers. A Halloween outing with a full concert-hall sound.
events.where: David Geffen Hall · 10 Lincoln Center Plaza
events.cost: Paid reserved seats; current seat prices not confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Daniel Kaluuya in a Get Out film still supplied by the New York Philharmonic

events.title: Jason Takes Manhattan with a live hip-hop soundtrack
events.what: Shaolin Jazz pairs the 1989 horror film with a live musical soundtrack from DJ 2-Tone Jones. This is a film screening with live music, recommended for ages 17+.
events.cost: Free Atrium event; entry is subject to capacity.
events.imageAlt: A previous Shaolin Jazz live-score screening, from Lincoln Center’s event page

events.title: Halloween crafts at the Museum of Arts and Design
events.what: Make masks, ghostly pompoms and pop-up art cards, and explore a playful inflatable sculpture installation. This is a family-friendly craft party rather than an adults-only evening.
events.where: Museum of Arts and Design · 2 Columbus Circle
events.cost: $10 general / $5 members; ages 12 and under free. Event tickets do not include museum admission.
events.imageAlt: Columbus Circle and the Museum of Arts and Design in its official visitor photograph

events.title: Park Slope’s Haunted Forest Halloween Parade
events.what: Watch or join the costumed neighborhood parade, then stay for spooky music from the Brooklyn Conservatory at the Old Stone House. It is a family-centered community celebration.
events.where: 7th Avenue at 14th Street → 3rd Street → Old Stone House
events.when: Sat Oct 31 · march 6:30 p.m.; participants line up at 6 p.m.
events.cost: Free street parade; any neighborhood purchases are optional.
events.imageAlt: Halloween decorations in a photograph from the Park Slope Civic Council’s archive

events.title: Dumboween: costumes, brass bands and the Archway
events.what: Start with the dog costume contest, follow the brass-band parade through Brooklyn Bridge Park, or stop by the Archway for crafts and live music. A lively family-friendly neighborhood celebration.
events.where: Washington Street at Front Street, then the Dumbo Archway
events.when: Sat Oct 31 · dogs 2 p.m.; parade 3 p.m.; Archway party 3:30–6 p.m.
events.cost: Neighborhood festivities and photo booth are free; bar purchases optional.
events.imageAlt: A previous Dumboween parade photographed by Phil Greenberg

events.title: A no-cover Halloween dance party at Freddy’s
events.what: DJ Evil Dee and Ben the Beyonder soundtrack Halloween at this South Slope neighborhood bar. Dress up for the costume contest and prizes; drinks are a separate purchase.
events.cost: Free admission / no cover; drinks extra.
events.imageAlt: Freddy’s Bar, from the venue’s official website

events.title: Halloween on the Farm
events.what: A daytime farm celebration with a corn maze, hayride and trick-or-treating. This is especially family-oriented and farther from Manhattan, so allow time for the trip. Food and pumpkins are separate.
events.where: Queens County Farm Museum · 73-50 Little Neck Parkway
events.cost: $15 adults / $25 ages 2–17; under 2 free. Optional food and pumpkins extra.
events.imageAlt: A previous Halloween celebration at Queens County Farm Museum

events.title: Día de Muertos with Guachinangos
events.what: Live cumbia and a community ofrenda celebrate a Mexican tradition of remembering loved ones and ancestors. An all-ages music gathering at the Atrium.
events.cost: Free Atrium event; admission subject to capacity.
events.imageAlt: Members of Guachinangos in Lincoln Center’s official artist photograph

events.title: Nature journaling after dark by the waterfront
events.what: A guided 90-minute workshop about nocturnal insects, mammals and noticing nature after sunset, with prompts and time to write. Meet at the north entrance of Pier 3 before the group moves at 5:35 p.m.; weather may affect plans.
events.where: Brooklyn Bridge Park · Pier 3 north entrance
events.cost: Free; advance registration requested.
events.imageAlt: Brooklyn Bridge Park’s official nature-journaling workshop photograph

events.title: Bring a worn sweater to MAD’s mending club
events.what: Patch sweaters, darn socks or repair sleeves with tools and supplies provided. Fiber artist J Hann facilitates; beginners can learn alongside experienced menders. Bring a garment that needs attention.
events.where: Museum of Arts and Design · 2 Columbus Circle
events.cost: Workshop included with museum admission on a pay-what-you-wish evening; advance registration recommended.
events.imageAlt: An embroidery hoop and sewing tools in MAD’s mending-club photograph

events.title: Gen’ichirō Inokuma’s New York art circle
events.what: Paintings, photographs, film and letters trace Inokuma’s 20 years in New York and friendships across the city’s postwar art world. An indoor exhibition that connects art with the story of a creative neighborhood.
events.when: Through Jan 10 · Tue–Fri 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sat–Sun noon–6 p.m.; closed Mondays and major holidays
events.cost: $20 general / $15 students and seniors. Free admission Nov 6, 5–7 p.m.; regular hours are not free.
events.imageAlt: Gen’ichirō Inokuma in his 95th Street studio in 1960; photograph courtesy of MIMOCA

events.title: Paper Cuts: a world of zines and independent publishing
events.what: Explore independent publishing through a selection drawn from more than 600 zines and small-press works, with reading tables and a large visual installation. A quiet, creative alternative to a large museum.
events.where: Center for Book Arts · 28 West 27th Street, third floor
events.when: Through Dec 12 · Mon–Thu 11 a.m.–6 p.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday
events.cost: Free admission; donations optional.
events.imageAlt: Zines from the first year of Paper Cuts; photo courtesy of Christopher Kardambikis

events.title: Salon Art + Design at the Park Avenue Armory
events.what: Browse collectible furniture, lighting and art from galleries in the Armory’s dramatic drill hall. Public admission begins Friday; the earlier previews are invitation-only.
events.cost: $37.50 single-day general admission including fees; $68.50 full-show pass.
events.imageAlt: Visitors at a previous Salon Art + Design fair in the Park Avenue Armory

events.title: Too Many Zooz at Brooklyn Bowl
events.what: A high-energy brass trio blending jazz, dance music and punk, with Thundersmack opening. The New York group grew from subway busking into a touring act. Concert admission and bowling are separate purchases.
events.when: Fri Oct 30 · doors 6 p.m.; show 8 p.m.; all ages
events.cost: Paid concert ticket; current price not confirmed. Bowling costs extra.
events.imageAlt: Too Many Zooz in the venue’s official artist photograph

events.title: Beetlejuice under the Hudson Yards skyline
events.what: Bring a blanket for an outdoor screening of Tim Burton’s 1988 comedy. Complimentary popcorn is available while supplies last. Doors open an hour before the film; check the event’s final screening details before setting out.
events.where: Public Square and Gardens · Hudson Yards
events.cost: No admission price listed; complimentary popcorn while supplies last.
events.imageAlt: An outdoor movie screening at Hudson Yards, photographed by the organizer

events.title: A free community walk or run with Rhone
events.what: Join the Extra Mile Series for an all-levels walk, jog or run through the city. A social outdoor workout rather than a race; use the organizer’s registration link and wear comfortable shoes.
events.where: Public Square and Gardens · Hudson Yards
events.cost: Free; register through the event page.
events.imageAlt: A runner in Rhone’s official Extra Mile Series photograph

events.title: Halloween takes over Mott Street
events.what: An acrobatic parade, DJ, photo booths and trick-or-treating fill a car-free stretch of Chinatown. This is a family-friendly community celebration, with games and giveaways throughout the afternoon.
events.where: Mott Street · Canal Street to Bayard Street
events.cost: Free admission; all ages. Optional neighborhood food purchases extra.
events.imageAlt: Chinatown neighborhood photograph by Amanda Dalbjorn, featured by Chinatown Partnership

events.title: Cheer the marathon from the museum terrace
events.what: Watch runners pass the marathon’s 23-mile mark from the Museum of the City of New York’s front terrace. Bring your cheering voice and warm layers; the cash bar is optional.
events.where: Museum of the City of New York · 1220 Fifth Avenue at 103rd Street
events.cost: Free watch party; cash-bar purchases extra.
events.source: Museum of the City of New York
events.imageAlt: The Museum of the City of New York’s front steps; photograph by Filip Wolak

events.title: A book-club evening for 2001: A Space Odyssey
events.what: Marie-Helene Bertino leads a conversation with Rivka Galchen, Alice Sola Kim and Joshua Rothman about Arthur C. Clarke’s novel, with a reading by Stephen Lang. Expect a literary discussion and audience Q&A, not a film screening.
events.where: Leonard Nimoy Thalia · Symphony Space, 250 West 95th Street
events.cost: $19–$27, plus the listed $5 handling fee.
events.imageAlt: Official participant portraits for the Thalia Book Club’s Space Odyssey event

events.title: Grey Gardens: songs and stories, 20 years later
events.what: Christine Ebersole, Erin Davie and Scott Frankel revisit the musical with selections and behind-the-scenes memories. This is an anniversary celebration, not a full staging of the show. VIP tickets add an after-party.
events.where: Peter Jay Sharp Theatre · Symphony Space, 2537 Broadway
events.cost: Page lists $75–$250; the booking widget also shows lower-priced options. Confirm your seat total.
events.imageAlt: Official cast photographs for the Grey Gardens anniversary celebration

events.title: Walk Chelsea’s flower and fashion history
events.what: Architectural historian Matt Postal traces the West 20s from Tin Pan Alley to garment-industry buildings, FIT and the flower district. Registration supplies the exact meeting point; this is a guided two-hour neighborhood walk.
events.where: West 20s · exact meeting point supplied after registration
events.cost: $35 general / $25 MAS members.
events.imageAlt: High School of Fashion Industries in Chelsea; photograph by Matt Postal

events.title: MoMA’s Contenders film season opens
events.what: MoMA’s annual film series revisits notable new releases with filmmaker conversations. Opening night pairs Obsession with a conversation between Curry Barker and Rian Johnson. Choose a specific screening from the program.
events.where: Museum of Modern Art · 11 West 53rd Street
events.when: Oct 28–Dec 17 · individual screening dates and times vary
events.cost: Film ticket required; current screening prices and availability are on the linked program.
events.imageAlt: An Obsession film still supplied by MoMA for The Contenders

events.title: 3.1 Phillip Lim’s SoHo sample sale
events.what: Browse the brand’s in-person sample sale at 260’s Lafayette Street space. Inventory and prices vary; allow for a queue and check the sale’s purchase rules before going.
events.when: Oct 27–Nov 1 · Tue–Sat 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sun 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
events.cost: Merchandise prices vary; no admission price listed.
events.imageAlt: 3.1 Phillip Lim fashion photograph supplied by 260 Sample Sale

events.title: Marc Jacobs at the Fifth Avenue sample sale
events.what: A six-day sale at 260’s flagship location. Treat it as an optional browse, with changing selection and sale-specific purchase policies; no particular item or discount is guaranteed.
events.cost: Merchandise prices vary; no admission price listed.
events.imageAlt: 260 Sample Sale’s New York storefront, from the organizer’s official locations page

events.title: Halloween bingo with a dance-floor energy
events.what: Bingo Loco mixes bingo, music, dance-offs and prizes for a loud, costume-friendly night. Shared tables are first come, first served. Ages 21+ with valid ID; arrive early if you want to sit together.
events.when: Fri Oct 30 · doors 5:30 p.m.; show 7:30–10 p.m.
events.cost: Tickets from $42; check checkout fees. Food and drinks extra.
events.imageAlt: HK Hall’s event space in an official venue photograph

events.title: A Halloween rooftop party over the East River
events.what: DJs and skyline views take over Time Out Market’s fifth-floor rooftop. The event pairs a late-night Halloween atmosphere with specialty cocktails; follow the RSVP link and check entry requirements.
events.where: Time Out Market · 55 Water Street, fifth floor
events.cost: Free admission listed by Dumbo BID; drinks cost extra. RSVP through the event page.
events.source: Dumbo Improvement District / Time Out Market
events.imageAlt: Time Out Market New York’s dining space, from its official website

events.title: BOOgardus: a little Halloween stop in Tribeca
events.what: A neighborhood plaza turns into a Halloween gathering with a spooky walk and photo opportunities. This is a family-oriented community stop, easy to combine with a walk around Tribeca.
events.where: Bogardus Plaza · Hudson Street and West Broadway near Chambers Street
events.cost: No admission price listed for the public-plaza festivities.
events.source: Friends of Bogardus Plaza / NYC DOT
events.imageAlt: Bogardus Plaza in a photograph from Friends of Bogardus Plaza

events.title: Textiles become sculptures in In Fragments
events.what: Elodie Blanchard turns collected clothing, fabric and Mylar balloons into sculptural trees, vessels and expansive sewn compositions. An intimate gallery discovery for an afternoon downtown; check gallery opening hours.
events.when: Oct 30–Dec 12 · Tue–Fri 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sat 11 a.m.–6 p.m.
events.cost: No admission charge listed; artwork purchases are optional.
events.imageAlt: Elodie Blanchard’s Corne d’abondance, 2026, photographed for Jane Lombard Gallery

events.title: Costumes and $5 beers at Sixpoint
events.what: The taproom’s all-day Halloween party adds live music, a costume contest and candy giveaways. The advertised beer special covers Bone Chiller and The Crisp; food and other drinks are separate purchases.
events.where: Sixpoint Brewery at Brookfield Place · 200 Liberty Street
events.cost: No admission charge stated; advertised beers $5 each, other purchases extra.
events.imageAlt: Sixpoint Brewery’s Brookfield Place exterior, photographed by the venue

events.title: Last days of Oktoberfest in Loreley’s garden
events.what: Seasonal German beers, soft pretzels and sausages in a heated outdoor garden, now decorated for Halloween. This is a casual seasonal beer-garden outing; food and drinks are paid individually.
events.when: Through Sat Oct 31 · opens noon daily
events.cost: Free admission; food and drinks cost extra.
events.imageAlt: Loreley’s official Oktoberfest photograph

events.title: Pier 17 pumpkin arch
events.cost: Free; no RSVP required.
events.what: A pumpkin-covered waterfront arch for a short fall stroll and photos. Come for the installation itself; rooftop concerts and Halloween parties are separate events.
events.imageAlt: The Seaport’s waterfront pumpkin arch in an organizer photograph

events.title: Halloween beneath the cathedral
events.where: Cathedral of St. John the Divine · 1047 Amsterdam Avenue
events.cost: Paid guided tour; current price appears in the cathedral’s booking calendar.
events.what: Explore the cathedral’s crypt and the origins of Halloween with a guide. Ages 12+; stairs and uneven surfaces mean comfortable shoes are important. Reserve a timed tour before going.
events.imageAlt: Cathedral photograph accompanying its Halloween Crypt Crawl listing

events.title: Village Halloween Costume Ball
events.where: Theater for the New City · 155 First Avenue
events.when: Oct 31 · free outdoor shows 3–7 p.m.; indoor ball from 7 p.m.
events.cost: $20 indoor admission; outdoor performances free. Optional dinner $5.
events.what: Cabaret, aerial acts, live bands and dancing fill the theater for Halloween. Wear a costume or formal attire for the indoor ball. The inexpensive dinner starts at 8 p.m.
events.imageAlt: Theater for the New City’s Community Space; venue photograph, not a photograph of this year’s ball

events.title: Paranormal Activity under the city lights
events.where: Outside the August Wilson Theatre · 245 West 52nd Street
events.cost: Free; bring your own chair or blanket.
events.what: Watch the original 2007 horror film outdoors in front of the theater. Dress warmly, arrive early and use the organizer’s RSVP form if you plan to attend.
events.imageAlt: Official night-vision bedroom still from the original Paranormal Activity film

events.title: A Halloween movie crawl at Chelsea Market
events.when: Oct 31 · Dickson’s screenings at noon, 2, 4 and 6 p.m.
events.cost: No screening ticket price listed by the market; food and drinks extra.
events.what: Dickson’s lineup runs from Coco to Hocus Pocus, The Addams Family and Ghostbusters. Creamline also shows Ghostbusters at 5 p.m. These are screenings inside market businesses, so plan around the seating available.
events.imageAlt: Chelsea Market’s photograph of its Halloween-decorated market

events.title: Día de Muertos at St. Mark’s
events.cost: Free admission; market purchases optional.
events.what: Visit the community ofrenda, Mexican folk-art market and workshops. Saturday brings a 3 p.m. concert; Sunday has dance at 2 p.m. and mariachi at 3 p.m. Rain or shine; RSVP encouraged.
events.imageAlt: Interior of St. Mark’s Church-in-the-Bowery during a church gathering; venue photograph, not the Día de Muertos event

events.title: Canal Street’s car-free Halloween afternoon
events.where: Canal Street between Orchard and Essex Streets
events.cost: Free street celebration.
events.what: A neighborhood Halloween gathering with live music, interactive performances and activities on the Open Street. The separately ticketed MAS tree walk is sold out; the street celebration remains the option here.
events.imageAlt: NYC DOT photograph of a previous Trick-or-Streets celebration on Vernon Boulevard, illustrating the program

events.title: Kimera: a free Halloween music afternoon
events.when: Oct 31 · music from 2 p.m.; costume parade 5 p.m.
events.cost: Free; nearby food purchases optional.
events.what: Hear Horacio Martinez’s South American jazz fusion at 3 p.m. and Tállia at 4 p.m. The outdoor festival ends its main lineup with a costume parade; pets are welcome. Check the organizer for rain updates.
events.imageAlt: Peace Fountain sculpture near the Kimera festival site, pictured by the organizer

events.title: Diwali through music, dance and food
events.when: Nov 1 · noon–4 p.m.; dance drama 2:15 p.m.
events.cost: $20 adults; $15 member adults; children free. Food extra.
events.what: Try henna, rangoli, block printing and dance workshops from noon to 2 p.m., then watch Abha B. Roy and Srijan Dance Company’s Indian Wedding performance. Queens Curry Kitchen sells food throughout.
events.imageAlt: Flushing Town Hall’s photograph for its Diwali dance celebration

events.title: Halloween at the waterfront food hall
events.when: Oct 31 · 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; caricatures noon–6 p.m.
events.cost: No admission ticket listed; food and drinks extra.
events.what: Pair a waterfront visit with Halloween films and trick-or-treating at the market’s kiosks. Caricature artists are scheduled for the afternoon; this is an all-ages, family-oriented event.
events.imageAlt: Pier 57’s photograph of Market 57’s interior

events.title: Welcome the Rockefeller Center tree
events.when: Nov 7 · Meet the Tree Day 10 a.m.–1 p.m.
events.cost: Free first-come entry; expedited Top of the Rock package costs extra.
events.what: See the tree arrive and stop by the holiday workshop with Care Bears and FAO Schwarz. This is the arrival celebration: the tree will not be illuminated until December 2. Expect a family crowd.
events.imageAlt: Rockefeller Center’s photograph of a previous tree arrival

events.title: A ranger-led Halloween forest walk
events.where: Meet at West 218th Street and Indian Road · Inwood Hill Park
events.cost: Free; no registration required.
events.what: Join the Urban Park Rangers for a guided walk focused on bats, owls and local lore. Wear sturdy shoes for the hilly paths and bring a warm layer as daylight fades.
events.imageAlt: Inwood Hill Park, pictured in the neighborhood event listing

events.title: Leaf-peeping with the Urban Park Rangers
events.where: Meet at West 100th Street and Central Park West
events.cost: Free; optional transit costs extra.
events.what: Explore the North Woods with park rangers while the trees change color. This is a scheduled guided hike, so meet at the listed entrance and wear walking shoes; foliage intensity depends on the weather.
events.source: NYC Parks; photograph: Central Park Conservancy
events.imageAlt: A birder on a rustic North Woods bridge, photographed by Central Park Conservancy

events.title: Canstruction’s larger-than-life food sculptures
events.when: Oct 30–Nov 9 · 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; final day ends 6 p.m.
events.cost: Free exhibition; food donations optional.
events.what: Architects and designers build inventive sculptures entirely from cans of food. Walk through the public display and see how ordinary pantry items become intricate structures; donations support City Harvest.
events.imageAlt: A previous Canstruction display in Brookfield Place’s official photograph

events.title: Moroccan music tucked inside Chelsea Market
events.where: Imports from Marrakesh · Chelsea Market, 75 Ninth Avenue
events.cost: No admission charge listed; shopping optional.
events.what: Rachid Halihal and his students play Moroccan Andalusian music inside the shop. A small, informal live-music stop with no concert-hall commitment; all are welcome.
events.imageAlt: The Imports from Marrakesh shop at Chelsea Market, photographed by the event organizer

events.title: Hear the next generation of violin soloists
events.where: Greenfield Hall · Manhattan School of Music, 130 Claremont Avenue
events.cost: Free; RSVP through the organizer.
events.what: Listen to semifinalists from Naumburg’s international competition in an intimate concert hall. Each plays a 30-minute program; the jury chooses some selections, so this is a working competition rather than a single fixed recital.
events.imageAlt: Greenfield Hall at Manhattan School of Music, photographed by the organizer

events.title: The women who made the Village Gate matter
events.cost: $5 event admission; book purchase optional.
events.what: Soyica Diggs Colbert discusses Freedom’s Gate, tracing the art and activism of Maya Angelou, Lorraine Hansberry, Abbey Lincoln, Miriam Makeba and Nina Simone around the historic New York nightclub.
events.imageAlt: McNally Jackson Seaport’s bookshop, photographed by The Seaport

events.title: A free evening of new theater: The Bird Is Done
events.where: Theater for the New City · 155 First Avenue
events.cost: Free staged reading; donations welcome.
events.what: Hear Michael Fishman’s family dramedy in a staged reading directed by Jim Semmelman. The announced cast includes Mitch Poulos, Marilyn Chris and Liz Keifer. Arrive before curtain for seating.
events.imageAlt: Theater for the New City’s Community Space, an official venue photograph

events.title: Yoshitomo Nara’s new paintings and giant heads
events.where: David Zwirner · 537 West 20th Street and 533 West 19th Street
events.when: Nov 5–Dec 12 · check gallery opening hours before visiting
events.cost: Free gallery admission.
events.what: A major New York solo presentation brings together paintings, drawings and sculptures. The 19th Street gallery holds thirteen enlarged bronze heads; the 20th Street space focuses on paintings and related works.
events.imageAlt: Artwork from Yoshitomo Nara’s exhibition, courtesy of David Zwirner

events.title: Light sculptures that bend like ribbons
events.where: Museum of Arts and Design · 2 Columbus Circle
events.when: Opens Oct 27; through Apr 4 · museum closed Mondays
events.cost: $20 general admission; seniors $16; students $14.
events.what: John Procario’s sculptural lighting explores the movement of bent wood and light. Pair the new exhibition with the museum’s other design galleries. First-Wednesday pay-what-you-wish is a special window, not everyday free admission.
events.imageAlt: John Procario’s sculptural lighting, photographed for the Museum of Arts and Design

events.title: A Louisiana love story with a surreal twist
events.where: Theater for the New City · 155 First Avenue
events.cost: $25; students/seniors $15; Sundays pay what you can.
events.what: Melanie Maria Goodreaux’s dark comedy places a dead crawfish farmer back in his own yard, where family, faith and old conflicts collide. Allow two hours for the performance.
events.imageAlt: The production’s Community Space Theater, photographed by Theater for the New City

events.title: Jewel-toned paintings at 52 Walker
events.cost: Free gallery admission.
events.what: Jem Perucchini’s Sospiro brings together luminous paintings and the first public presentation of his drawings. Renaissance imagery and African textiles inform the richly colored scenes; an intimate gallery stop rather than a museum-sized outing.
events.imageAlt: Jem Perucchini’s Sospiro, courtesy of the artist and Corvi-Mora, London

events.title: Salt & Stone’s Training Center pop-up
events.cost: Free to browse; products and limited-edition merchandise cost extra.
events.what: Explore the body-care brand’s scents and limited merchandise in its temporary Nolita space. Some promotional gifts require a purchase; check the organizer’s terms and availability before making a special trip.
events.imageAlt: Salt & Stone’s Santal & Vetiver deodorant in the brand’s product photograph; illustrative image

events.title: A tiny holiday chalet beside the rink
events.cost: Reservation ticket plus a $25 food-and-drink minimum per person; skating is separate.
events.what: Reserve a small private chalet for up to six people, with food and drinks from 5 Acres. Two digital photographs are included. The tree arrives Nov 7 and is not illuminated until Dec 2, so early visits are about the setting rather than a lit tree.
events.imageAlt: Rockefeller Center’s photograph of its holiday chalets in a previous season

events.title: Actors, music and a people’s history
events.cost: Free, first-come admission; free Fast Track reservations open Nov 2 at noon.
events.what: Wallace Shawn, Jessica Hecht and Arian Moayed join musicians and writers for readings inspired by Howard Zinn and Dave Zirin’s biography. A varied evening of spoken word and music; arrive early if you do not have Fast Track.
events.imageAlt: Portraits of the evening’s participating artists, supplied by Lincoln Center
